card.name: Footnote symbols in label tables
card.fires_on: Footnote marker symbols such as § or ° that appear right after a table entry or phrase in drug-label tables, and also the degree sign in temperatures.

modes.label: Section sign footnote
modes.description: The § mark placed after a row label or column heading in a dosing or trial table, pointing to a note.
modes.example: Moderate to Severe Pneumonia<< §>> 1 to 2 g IV Every

modes.label: Degree sign
modes.description: The ° mark used as a footnote marker or in a temperature before C.

card.plain: It fires on small footnote symbols like § and ° that sit inside tables and temperature ranges in drug labels.
